shots.typography: Native web/product text only: the article uses a serif body face with bold sans-serif heading and bold lead-in sentences per bullet (Medium-style fonts, low-confidence guess), sentence case, default tracking; the extension popup uses small regular sans-serif UI labels; no added captions or kinetic type
shots.what_happens: Opens on the full browser showing the Onboarding templates idea (about 50.0-50.5 s) while the VO says 'dropping a link or better again using the Chrome extension' (w158-w167); the presenter switches to a second tab with a UX article, which appears briefly cropped in (about 51.0-51.5 s) before the full browser frame returns. The cursor drag-selects the heading and four bullets so they turn highlight-blue (about 53.0-56.0 s, w168-w177); an author hover card briefly pops up near 54.5 s. The extension icon is clicked and a popup appears top-right (about 56.0 s, w178): its Idea field drop-down lists ideas, the presenter types a partial query, picks 'Onboarding templates' (about 59.0-59.5 s, w179-w183), and the popup shows the Add/Cancel buttons as the VO finishes 'into your product discovery' (w184-w187). The popup and hover card cast soft drop shadows. Small popup labels are too low-resolution in the contact sheets to quote fully.
shots.build_rebuild: Show a full-bleed screen capture of a browser article, animate a text-selection highlight sweeping down the paragraphs, then pop a 360px extension card with drop shadow at the top-right containing a searchable idea select that types a query and resolves to 'Onboarding templates' with an Add button.
